evidencePolicy: All136 numbered steps manually inspected in rendered PDF imagery. Editorial observations are not manual quotations. Exact quantities below are visible parts-callout quantities, summed once at introduction. Null is unknown, never an inferred count. Catalogue inventories are not build quantities.
privateArtifactPolicy: Downloaded PDFs, rendered pages, and screenshots are private research artifacts under .research-cache/advanced-driving-base, not distributable app/static assets. Public availability does not grant redistribution rights.

geometryCrosswalk.authority: Contextual source-shape and material selection by build/local key; geometryId is an LDraw basename, not a certified manufacturer element ID or exact2019 mold. inventoryEvidence.accounting: Each visible new-parts callout counted once; installation-only / camera-turn pages have no new parts. Reused subassemblies are not added again. Hub counted as one assembled hub with battery; battery insertion on assembly PDF p3 is unnumbered preparation, not a second hub. Integral motor/sensor cables are not independent BOM pieces.
inventoryEvidence.quantityStatus: All introduction quantities transcribed from visible callouts; ambiguous shape identifiers are explicitly unresolved even when their counts are exact.

firstVerifiedSubassembly.name: Front bracket seed
firstVerifiedSubassembly.scope: Book1 steps1–3 only; not the complete38-step Front Part
firstVerifiedSubassembly.status: Source-verified attachment topology; not a fully registered CAD assembly

coordinateConvention.x: Along black9-hole beam from upper-left end h1 toward lower-right end h9 in book1 p1
coordinateConvention.y: Across beam hole axes, positive from far face toward visible near face in book1 p1
coordinateConvention.z: Upward through grey connector end holes in book1 p3
coordinateConvention.coordinateOrigin: Center of black beam h1 at mid-depth; physical placement of non-beam attachment planes remains null
coordinateConvention.pitchStatus: Exact adjacent hole pitch20LDU read from LDraw40490.dat; conversion to8mm is approximate under LDraw scale, not a dimension printed in the manual. These are attachment anchors, not DAT part-origin transforms.
coordinateConvention.beamDatConvention: 40490.dat long axis is Z and hole axes Y; scene seed uses editorial x/y/z axes and requires explicit registration.

components.insertionAxis: -y for the integral pins entering the black beam; opposite integral pins project +y

components.targetFeature: outermost upward-facing round hole of each grey connector

uncertainties: No insertion depth or connector-plane y/z coordinate is dimensioned by the manual.
No numeric Euler camera angles are provided; camera orientation is the explicit qualitative page convention above.
Element IDs come from official2021 overview visual matching; 2019 mold variants require DAT comparison.

relationships.name: Left propulsion

relationships.gearRatioStatus: Derived from directly pinned output-to-wheel connection; not printed numeric ratio

relationships.gearRatioStatus: Derived from direct pinned output connection

relationships.name: Front tool output
relationships.kind: Grey gear pinned directly onto upward medium motor output; no mating external gear or independent tool in these five manuals

relationships.name: Rear tool output
relationships.kind: Grey gear pinned directly onto upward medium motor output; no attached independent tool

relationships.name: Sensors
relationships.kind: Two downward-facing front sensors, mounted beside caster units; B/F connection arrows are explicit; world-left/right assignment not numerically registered

relationships.name: Caster support
relationships.kind: Two passive ball-in-cup support units beside front sensors; no steering servo, track or distance sensor shown

relationships.name: Structural closure
